notes: Verbatim from the NY Fed's own publication: 12 northern NJ counties + Fairfield County CT (+ NY state, PR, USVI). NJ complement (9 southern counties) -> Philadelphia; CT complement (7 counties) -> Boston. CT caveat: the Fed defines the boundary by the historical Fairfield County; Census/LAUS moved CT to planning regions in the 2020s, so legacy-county LAUS series may truncate in the early 2020s.
